questions.text: Is climate action the core purpose or goal of the policy?
questions.answer: The policy's core purpose is indeed climate action. The policy outlines a comprehensive plan to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and transition to a zero-carbon community by 2040. This is evident in the policy's focus on three key areas: stationary energy, transport, and waste. The policy aims to drive emissions reductions in these areas through a series of five-yearly Zero Carbon Action Plans. These plans will set medium-term targets and map out priority projects and programs. The policy also emphasizes the importance of monitoring progress towards the zero-carbon vision, with annual progress reports to the Council and four-yearly community greenhouse gas emissions profiles. The policy also acknowledges the need for advocacy, particularly in relation to planning policy and environmentally sustainable design standards for new buildings.

quote.content: The Framework reflects our focus on driving emissions reductions across the three key sources of the Moreland community’s greenhouse gas emissions: stationary energy, transport and waste.

questions.answer: The document indeed calls for rapid and urgent action on climate change. questions.text: Does the document give specific timeframes for its intended actions on climate?
questions.answer: The document does indeed provide specific timeframes for its intended actions on climate change. The Moreland Zero Carbon – 2040 Framework outlines a 20-year plan from 2020 to 2040 to reduce emissions across three target areas: energy transition, sustainable transport, and waste and consumption. The framework is designed to be flexible to accommodate the dynamic social, political, and technological context. It sets out key priorities for the first five years (2020 – 2025) and plans to review and reset these priorities every five years. Five-yearly Zero Carbon Action Plans will be developed to set medium-term targets and map out priority projects and programs. The document also mentions an annual progress report to the Council and a four-yearly community greenhouse gas emissions profile. This approach allows for regular review and adjustment of the plans in response to changing circumstances while maintaining a clear long-term vision and commitment to achieving zero carbon by 2040.

quote.content: Five-yearly Zero Carbon Action Plans will be developed to set medium-term targets and map out priority projects and programs. This Moreland Zero Carbon – 2040 Framework defines the key priorities for driving emissions reductions across the three target areas: energy transition, sustainable transport and waste and consumption over the first five years (2020 – 2025) and beyond. The key priorities for action and advocacy outcomes within the Framework will be reviewed each five years and re-set for the following five-years.
